# CodeEditLanguages vendored for Foundry's editor trial

Upstream: https://github.com/CodeEditApp/CodeEditLanguages

Snapshot: tag `0.1.20`, commit `331d5dbc5fc8513be5848fce8a2a312908f36a11`.

This local package avoids fetching the upstream repository's large Git history when resolving the editor. Repository metadata, CI, tests, and the binary-build project were omitted; the published language binary and source are retained.

The upstream repository does not include a top-level license file in this snapshot. Review distribution rights for the package and its bundled grammars before shipping this vendored copy.
